name: select
summary: Kit's raw Ant a-select wrapper. LOW-USE (2x, both mode=tags) — the product's select is FlotoDropdownPicker (510x). Modes default/multiple/tags; v-model value/change.

options.note: { value, text } objects; or slot a-select-option

accessibility.semantics: real Ant combobox — role/aria-expanded/aria-activedescendant, listbox/options, keyboard open + type-ahead
accessibility.note: MORE accessible than FlotoDropdownPicker (SF-003); a reference for fixing SF-003

decisionFlow: Need the product's standard select (single/multi/search/virtualized/custom trigger)? -> FlotoDropdownPicker (the norm, 510x).
Specifically need the raw Ant a-select primitive? -> MSelect (rare, 2x).

default(single).useWhen: raw single Ant select (rare) — prefer FlotoDropdownPicker

multiple.useWhen: raw multi Ant select (rare) — prefer FlotoDropdownPicker multiple

single.useWhen: You specifically need the raw Ant a-select single-select primitive (mode=default) — the low-level combobox with optional show-search and allow-clear. Effectively a reference/primitive case; in this product a real single select is almost never MSelect.
single.dontUse: For any actual single-select in a form or filter bar, use FlotoDropdownPicker (the product norm, 510x) instead — it handles search, virtualized lists, custom triggers, and inline-add. Also avoid relying on allow-clear here: the clear × renders blank (fas icon not registered, F4) and overlaps the chevron (F5); use FlotoDropdownPicker when you need a clearable select.
single.example: Low-level primitive only — no product single-select ships on MSelect; every real dropdown (column selector, severity picker, monitor/group selection) uses FlotoDropdownPicker.

do: For a real select use FlotoDropdownPicker; for a tag input use LooseTags.
Use MSelect only as the low-level Ant primitive when raw a-select is specifically needed.
Wrap in FlotoFormItem for label + validation.
dont: Don't introduce new MSelect usages as 'the select' (that's FlotoDropdownPicker).
Don't use mode=tags here — use LooseTags.
whenToUse: Rarely — FlotoDropdownPicker is the product select. MSelect is the low-level Ant primitive.
knownIssues: F1 (medium): superseded by FlotoDropdownPicker (2x vs 510x) — effectively legacy/low-level. Use DropdownPicker for selects, LooseTags for tag inputs.
F2 (medium, a11y, ironic): MSelect IS an accessible combobox (Ant) while the widely-used FlotoDropdownPicker is NOT (SF-003). Mirror Ant's ARIA when fixing SF-003.
F3 (high, a11y): no visible focus ring (SF-001).

F4 (low): clear x is invisible — Select.vue hardcodes clearIcon as <MIcon name=times-circle type=fas> (FA solid) but only fal (light) icons are registered (639 fal, 0 fas). type=fas used 3x (Select, TreeSelect, navbar). Chip remove x works (fal times). Fix: drop type=fas (use fal) or register fas set.

F5 (low): clear x overlaps the dropdown chevron — the custom suffixIcon chevron (MIcon) is wider than Ant's clear mask box, so the chevron's left edge pokes out beside the x (chevron left 123, clear left 129). Fix: hide .ant-select-arrow while clearing, or widen the mask. NET (F4+F5): MSelect clear-all is broken; catalog stories omit allow-clear and show chip-remove; use FlotoDropdownPicker for a clearable select.

[element] obs-select: the option-menu now renders in the TOP LAYER (Popover API) so it positions correctly inside a transform-animated ancestor (e.g. a sliding drawer) — C4 fixed. Event detail is an array (unwrap detail[0]).

[rule] Searchable is AUTOMATIC by option count: obs-select shows the search box only when the list has more than ~8 options (long lists — monitors/hosts/types); short lists (status/severity/priority ≤8) render WITHOUT search, which scans faster. Override with searchable / searchable="false". Applies to the obs-filters value dropdown too.

[fix elements@0.1.19] disabled-options now greys+locks STRING options too (leafOf only set disabled for object options → string lists silently ignored disabled-options). And canUserAddOptions now FORCES the search row so the inline-add "+" shows even when the auto-searchable threshold would hide the box (the "+" lives inside the search row).

[rule] The PRODUCT dropdown (FlotoDropdownPicker) is SEARCHABLE BY DEFAULT — "not searchable" is the explicit opt-out (119× via :searchable=false). obs-select adds an auto-by-count opinion (search only >~8 options) for value pickers; to match the product on a short list, set searchable explicitly.
changelog: 2026-08-06 — Hardening: stop the internal native <input> `input` event from leaking out of the shadow DOM (@input.stop) so a stray composed native `input` (e.detail=0) can no longer reach consumer listeners on the host. Same class of fix as obs-input.

2026-06-07: added (badged low-use, decision-grade). Ant a-select wrapper — modes default/multiple/tags, show-search, allow-clear (default true), sizes, loading, slots (notFoundContent->MNoData); v-model value/change. Verified single/multiple/tags. F1 (superseded 2x vs 510x), F2 (accessible vs SF-003), F3 (focus).
2026-07-10: fixed disabled-options for string option lists + inline-add search row (elements@0.1.19). Clarified searchable: product default is searchable; auto-by-count is a DS opinion.

2026-07-10: searchable rule finalized (elements@0.1.20) — auto-by-count stays the DEFAULT, but inline-add (canUserAddOptions) and two-pane (useAfterMenuDescription) ALWAYS force the search box (they intrinsically need it). Explicit searchable / searchable=false still override the count.
$tokensNote: Dropdown/selected highlight uses the kit Ant accent @primary-color (#099dd9, kit-accents.json); other Ant Select internals follow the kit, not variables.json.

a11y.summary: role=combobox + aria-expanded + aria-activedescendant; listbox of options. Enter/Space/↓ open, type-ahead, Esc close. Label via FlotoFormItem/aria-label.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
